t: Blue passivated zinc-plated screws with countersunk heads, cross drive PZ and full thread. The countersunk head allows for surface flush installation in wood. The integrated thread, which runs throughout the entire screw length, ensures the optimum transfer of force. Suitable for fixing load-bearing components in coated wood, hardwood, softwood and timber connections such as car port fixings and balconies.
b: Single Thread Designed to Cut Fast
Wont Split Wood Even Close to Edges
